scripts:
create path (sling:OrderedFolder) /content
create path (sling:Folder) /apps
create path (sling:Folder) /libs
create path (sling:Folder) /var/workflow/models
create path (sling:Folder) /var/workflow/instances
create path (sling:Folder) /conf/global/settings/workflow/models
create service user studio-workflow-service
set ACL for studio-workflow-service
    allow jcr:all on /var/workflow
    allow jcr:read,rep:write,jcr:versionManagement,jcr:lockManagement on /content
    allow jcr:read,rep:write on /conf
    allow jcr:read on /libs
    allow jcr:read on /apps
    allow jcr:read on /home
end
